questions.question: A can complete (3)/(8) of a certain work in 9 days and B can complete 80% of the same work in 16 days. Both work together for 5 days. C alone completes the remaining work in 6 (1)/(2) days. A and C together will complete the whole work in:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A can complete (3)/(8) of a work in 9 days

B can complete 80% of the work in 16 days

**Formula Used:**

Total Work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

Time required by A to complete the work = 9over {3over8} = 9 × 8over3 = 24 days

Time required by B to complete the work = 16over {80over100} = 16 × 100over80 = 20 days

Let the total work be 120 units (LCM of 24, 20)

Efficiency of A = 120 ÷ 24 = 5 units/day

Efficiency of B = 120 ÷ 20 = 6 units/day

Combined efficiency of A and B = 5 + 6 = 11 units/day

Work done by A and B in 5 days = 11 × 5 = 55 units

Remaining work = 120 - 55 = 65 units or 65over120 part of the work

According to the question

65over120 part of the work is done by C in 6 (1)/(2) days

Time required by C to complete the total work

⇒ {13over2}over {65over120} = 13over 2 × 120over65 = 12 days

Efficiency of C = 120 ÷ 12 = 10 units/day

Combined efficiency of A and C = 5 + 10 = 15 units/day

Time taken by A and C to complete the work = 120 ÷ 15 = 8 days

**∴ A and C would complete the work in 8 days.**

questions.question: A person purchased a machine for ₹50,000 and fixed the marked price 20% higher than the cost price and sold it at a discount of 15%. The percentage profit or loss is:

MP is 20% higher than the CP

**2**. SP = MP × [(100 - Discount%)/100]

**3**. Profit% = [(SP - CP)/CP] × 100

SP = ₹60,000 × (85/100) = ₹51,000

⇒ Profit% = [(51000 - 50000)/50000] × 100 = 2%

**∴ The percentage profit is 2%.**

⇒ Profit % = [(102-100)/100] × 100 = 2%

∴ The percentage profit is 2%.

questions.question: The perimeter of a square is 64 cm. The area of a rectangle is 16 cm² less than the area of the square. If the length of the rectangle is 20 cm, what is the perimeter of the rectangle?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Side of the square = 64 ÷ 4 = 16 cm.

Area of the rectangle = 16² − 16 = 256 − 16 = 240 cm².

Breadth of the rectangle = 240 ÷ 20 = 12 cm.

Perimeter of the rectangle = 2 × (20 + 12) = 64 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 64 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Perimeter of the square = 64 cm

Length of the rectangle = 20 cm

**Formula Used:**

Perimeter of square = 4 × side

Area of square = side²

Area of rectangle = Length × Breadth

Perimeter of rectangle = 2 × (Length + Breadth)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/87fd145dc68931b14ba27aff1fb30509e9572155ba545a54413197641c83e489.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 4 × side = 64

⇒ side = 64 ÷ 4 = 16 cm

⇒ Area of the square = 16 × 16 = 256 cm²

⇒ Area of the rectangle = 256 − 16 = 240 cm²

⇒ Length × Breadth = 240

⇒ 20 × Breadth = 240

⇒ Breadth = 240 ÷ 20 = 12 cm

⇒ Perimeter of the rectangle = 2 × (20 + 12)

⇒ Perimeter = 2 × 32 = 64 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 64 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Rectangle Properties

Area = L × B | Perimeter = 2 × (L + B) | Diagonal = √(L² + B²)

Square Properties

Area = a² | Perimeter = 4a | Diagonal = a√2 (where a is the side length)

Rhombus Properties

Area = (d₁ × d₂) ÷ 2 | Perimeter = 4a (where d₁ and d₂ are diagonals)

Parallelogram Properties

Area = Base × Height | Perimeter = 2 × (Sum of adjacent sides)
